comment: M7-001: the eight-slot intent model is Q=1, W=2, E=3, R=4, A=5, S=6, D=7, F=8. The fighter default loadout fills the W/E/R/A/S hotbar slots (2..6); slot 1 (Q) stays the legacy weapon-fire slot, slot 7 (D) and slot 8 (F) stay empty per the control scheme (D keeps the legacy intent counting, F is the reserved eighth slot). launcher_z is NOT a loadout row: the Z launcher is a fixed input, not a hotbar skill, and is granted via professions.starting_skill_ranks. Loadout rows only reference hotbar-eligible skills of the same profession whose rank-1 row exists; the default loadout grants knowledge display but skills still need their rank purchased/owned before activation (M7-003 owns activation).
